qs.why: Odd positions are squares of 6, 7, 8, 9, and the even-position difference is -2; the required term is in an even position, where 10 is followed by 8 under its rule.

qs.q: 4, 8, 11, 9, 18, 21, 19, 38, ? The cycle repeats: multiply by a fixed integer greater than 1, add a fixed positive integer, then subtract a different fixed positive integer. What is the next number?
qs.why: The cycle is ×2, then +3, then −2; next add 3, giving 41.

qs.q: 9, 27, 30, 90, 93, ? Multiplication by a fixed integer greater than 1 alternates with addition of a fixed nonzero integer, starting with multiplication. What is the next number?
qs.why: Multiplying by 3 alternates with adding 3; next is multiplication, so 93 × 3 = 279.
